dataset_summary.plain_description: Normalized financial model dataset for The Widget Company Inc, containing forecast periods, product and pricing assumptions, general operating and financing assumptions, and long-form financial statement outputs.
dataset_summary.notes: The Inputs sheet was normalized into dimensions and long fact tables rather than kept as wide year-by-column blocks. The Calculations sheet was treated as intermediate model logic, while the Outputs sheet was normalized into financial statement line items and period values.
